title: Studio connector_action form shows no envelope editor and no in-form refusal for a template token in connectorConfig.input
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwb6hBqszPTYJobitm

Filing gate: ② should-fix ④.3 of the contract review of PR #28150 (#27968), record 6525595405. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and routes the card to the `ui/` lane.

Reach: an app builder editing a `connector_action` node in Studio. After #28150, a `{…}` token in `connectorConfig.input` is refused at publish. Studio's hand-written `connectorConfig` form offers no CEL-envelope editor for those values and shows no in-form refusal, so the builder meets the located refusal only at the runtime authoring gate. The verdict is right, but it arrives in the wrong place.

## Measured (on the #28150 head `6a06a420`)

- `flow-value-envelope.ts` `isValueEnvelopeSlot` answers true for `['config','input']` on `connector_action`. That path is unreachable, because the parse refuses the loose key. It never reads the ledger's `block` (`connectorConfig`).
- `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` `valueSlotRefusals` and `flow-simulator.ts:123` call the judge config-only.

## What changes

- The Studio readers honour the ledger's `block` root. The `connectorConfig.input` values get the same envelope editor and in-form refusal as other value slots.
- Add a test with a token typed into an input value, which shows the refusal in the form.
- This lands after #28150 merges.

Links: #27968, PR #28150 (record 6525595405).

Blocked-by: #28150
